item.title: Thursday 4 PM Update, Nov 19
item.description:
The Thursday 4 p.m. update from Gumshoe News Radio for November 19, 2026: Londonderry, New Hampshire weather through tomorrow; the Senate rejects another Iran war powers resolution, and Florida's flooding moves north as the St. Johns River breaks a 73-year record; a Houthi missile hits the tower of Saudi Arabia's wealth fund in Riyadh, and Jared Kushner says Russia is comfortable with NATO-style guarantees for Ukraine; Wall Street's closing slide on Anthropic's debut day; Tesla's Cybercab reaches Dallas; Gemini learns to run your Mac; a London transit data breach and a critical Drupal fix; your X feed; Nashua's library deal, a new Greyhound route and Friday football; and an 85-year-old Londonderry legend at the Burger King drive-thru. Anchor Ava, with Andrew at the business and tech desk.
